parsed.degree_signal: Master’s or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, AI, or a related field
parsed.notes:
Qualifications defaults to required; Preferred Skills makes its items nice_to_have. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities or company descriptions are excluded.
The degree label records the highest named degree, the preferred PhD; a bachelor’s degree is separately required in the posting.
Model development is independently required by the training qualification, so it leaves the experience alternative set; machine learning consequently has no remaining two-member group.
Distributed training is offered alongside edge inference and on-device ML, both unmapped; no singleton alternative_group is emitted. Multimodal learning is an unmapped additional alternative to generative AI and reinforcement learning.
Privacy-preserving ML is tentatively mapped to Data Privacy & Security; review the taxonomy fit.
Research-output contribution practices are retained as unmapped technical practices, rather than mapped to unrelated tooling. ML frameworks has no separate generic taxonomy entry; its concrete examples are labeled.
